import{fontStore}from/*"framer"*/'blob:https://site-8a30006c899d0745c3a710357e15fd182c9e9b24ba3f4c55e16da0b9cb.framercanvas.com/a7a92758-e9b8-4776-ac7c-f47c05a495ba';import{useEffect}from/*"react"*/'blob:https://site-8a30006c899d0745c3a710357e15fd182c9e9b24ba3f4c55e16da0b9cb.framercanvas.com/42cb2ed1-a23c-4f40-9412-9db6de069d12';import{fontStack}from/*"https://framerusercontent.com/modules/VTUDdizacRHpwbkOamr7/AykinQJbgwl92LvMGZwu/constants.js"*/'blob:https://site-8a30006c899d0745c3a710357e15fd182c9e9b24ba3f4c55e16da0b9cb.framercanvas.com/fb910e16-9c40-40ba-ac75-cfcb2b106f72';const fontWeights={100:"Thin",200:"Extra-light",300:"Light",400:"Regular",500:"Medium",600:"Semi-bold",700:"Bold",800:"Extra-bold",900:"Black"};export function useFontControls(props){const{fontFamily="Inter",fontSize=16,fontWeight=400,font=false}=props;const fontWeightName=fontWeights[fontWeight];const customFontStack=`"${fontFamily} ${fontWeightName}", "${fontFamily}", ${fontStack}`;const fontFamilyStyle=fontFamily?{fontSize,fontWeight,fontFamily:customFontStack}:{fontSize,fontWeight};const fetchCustomFonts=async()=>{await fontStore.loadWebFontsFromSelectors([`CUSTOM;${fontFamily}`,`CUSTOM;${fontFamily} ${fontWeightName}`,`GF;${fontFamily}-${fontWeightName.toLowerCase()}`,]).catch(e=>console.error(e));};useEffect(()=>{if(font)fetchCustomFonts();},[font,fontFamily,fontWeight]);return fontFamilyStyle;}
